SELECT polygon_id FROM vm_polygon_patch_config WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND industry_code = #{industryCode} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (device_code,channel_code,preset_id,layer_id, feature_id) IN
(#{item.deviceCode},#{item.channelCode},#{item.presetId},#{item.layerId},#{item.featureId})

SELECT `polygon_id` AS polygonId, `monitor_area_id` AS monitorAreaId, `polygon_points` AS polygonPoints, `device_code` AS deviceCode, `channel_code` AS channelCode, `preset_id` AS presetId, `preset_name` AS presetName, `layer_id` AS layerId, `layer_name` AS layerName, `feature_id` AS featureId, `create_by` AS createBy, `create_time` AS createTime, `update_by` AS updateBy, `update_time` AS updateTime FROM vm_polygon_patch_config WHERE delete_flag = 0
AND polygon_id = #{polygonId}

SELECT DISTINCT MAX(polygon_no) polygonNo, `device_code` AS deviceCode, `channel_code` AS channelCode, `preset_id` AS presetId, tenant_id, industry_code FROM vm_polygon_patch_config WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND (device_code, channel_code, preset_id, tenant_id, industry_code) in
(#{item.deviceCode}, #{item.channelCode}, #{item.presetId}, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.industryCode})
GROUP BY device_code,channel_code,preset_id,tenant_id,industry_code

SELECT DISTINCT t.*, t2.pan, t2.tilt, t2.zoom FROM vm_polygon_patch_config t LEFT JOIN vm_device_ref_point_valid_t t1 ON t.device_code = t1.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_device_info_t t3 ON t1.device_code = t3.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_video_preset t2 ON t.device_code = t2.device_code AND t.preset_id = t2.preset_id WHERE t.delete_flag = 0 AND t.preset_id IS NOT NULL AND t1.point_flag = '1' AND t3.device_model_code IS NOT NULL AND t3.height IS NOT NULL AND t.center_longitude IS NULL AND t2.pan IS NOT NULL AND t2.tilt IS NOT NULL AND t2.zoom IS NOT NULL
